newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean group urges cooperation on business crisi.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean group urges cooperation on business crisi.

text.p: The powerful Federation of Korean Industries (FKI) on Wednesday urged companies, financial institutions and the government to cooperate to overcome the nation's financial crisis.

The lobby group, which represents the nation's largest conglomerates or chaebols, said in a statement more needed to be done under a bail-out agreement in which financial institutions agreed to prevent promising companies from sinking under heavy debts.
The group released its statement after a meeting between representatives of financial institutions and corporate heads.
